SEVEN LITTLE SINS · A LITTLE TRANSPARENCY

Your information.
In plain language.

This notice describes the Seven Little Sins website at sevendeadlysinstest.xyz. It explains what stays in your browser, what a shared result reveals, and how website analytics and email work.

About the projectYour privacyContact & feedback
THE SHORT VERSION
  • Quiz answers are scored in your browser.
  • A result link contains seven scores.
  • GA4 measures visits when enabled.
  • Email reaches the inbox you choose to contact.
IN THIS GUIDEQuiz answersBrowser storageSharingAnalytics & cookiesHostingEmail & questionsYour choices

YOUR ANSWERS AND SCORES

The quiz runs
in your browser.

The site calculates your scores on your device. We do not submit your answers or scores to a quiz server, and there is no account registration or sign-in for the test.

The quiz saves an attempt and the latest result in this tab’s session storage so that refreshing can preserve your progress. This browser storage is separate from Google Analytics and its cookies.

WHAT IS SAVED LOCALLY

A tab’s progress,
not a user account.

Storage used by the quiz
ItemWhat it containsWhy it is used
Current attemptYour selected answers and current question.Resume an unfinished attempt after a refresh.
Latest resultThe seven calculated scores.Display your latest result in the same tab.

Session storage is scoped to a browser tab and browsing session. Browsers may restore sessions, so closing a window should not be treated as a guaranteed way to erase all browser-held data.

Start over resets the current attempt; it does not erase a previously saved result or Analytics cookies. To remove local attempts and results, use your browser’s controls to clear this site’s stored data. If storage is blocked or unavailable, the quiz still works, but progress may be lost on refresh.

SHARING IS A SEPARATE CHOICE

A card and a link
reveal different things.

A shared result URL includes all seven scores in its fragment, the part after #. Anyone who receives the complete link can view that profile. A URL fragment is not normally sent in the website’s HTTP request, but it remains visible in the link you copy or share.

The downloadable PNG is generated on your device and shows your leading character or characters without the numerical score chart. The site does not upload the card to an image service. Once you share a link or file through another service, that service and its recipients handle what you send.

Removing a saved local result does not revoke copies of links or PNG files already shared. The results guide explains the sharing choices.

WEBSITE MEASUREMENT

Google Analytics
and its cookies.

When enabled, the production website uses Google Analytics 4 to measure page visits and engagement. The Google tag can use cookies and collect technical visit information. Google explains that a browser visiting a site using its services sends information such as the page URL and IP address.

Our Analytics configuration does not include quiz answers, scores, or result fragments in the page information it sends. It removes arbitrary query values while retaining recognized campaign-attribution parameters. Google signals and advertising personalization are disabled in our tag configuration. Analytics is not loaded on localhost or preview domains.

Browser-held Analytics cookies and Analytics data already collected by Google are different things. Clearing local browser data does not itself delete data already processed by Google. Provider retention and processing are described in Google’s privacy policy and how Google uses information from partner sites.

Supported browsers can use Google’s Analytics opt-out browser add-on. You can also review cookie and site-data controls in your browser. Those controls do not prevent the ordinary network requests needed to load a page.

DELIVERING THE WEBSITE

Ordinary website requests.

The website is delivered through Cloudflare. Requests to load a page or asset involve technical information such as an IP address, requested path, request time, and browser headers. Hosting services may process this information to deliver content, maintain reliability, and protect the service.

Quiz answers are not added to those page requests by our quiz code. See Cloudflare’s privacy policy for information about its handling of end-user data.

WHEN YOU CONTACT THE PROJECT

The information
you choose to send.

Seven Little Sins uses xsanmei1@gmail.com for project questions and feedback. If you email us, your sender address, message, and any attachments are delivered to that Gmail inbox and handled by the mail providers involved. They are not erased when you close this website.

Messages are used to understand and respond to the topic you raise. Do not include quiz answers, a full result link, or other private information unless it is relevant and you choose to share it. A page URL with the part after # removed is usually enough to identify a website problem.

For questions about information you have sent, email the same address and describe the request. Avoid sending passwords, identity documents, or other sensitive material in an ordinary feedback message. Our contact page provides topic-specific email links.

YOUR AVAILABLE CONTROLS

A few practical choices.

  • Use Start over to reset the current quiz attempt.
  • Clear this site’s browser data to remove locally stored attempts, results, and cookies.
  • Share the quiz homepage instead of a personal result link if you want to keep your scores to yourself.
  • Review browser cookie settings or Google’s supported Analytics opt-out option.
  • Contact xsanmei1@gmail.com with questions about this notice or a message you have sent.

This notice describes the features currently implemented on this site. If the way those features handle information changes, the explanation here should be updated to match.
